definitions.explanation: To engage in competition with one another, each trying to outperform the other.

definitions.gloss: to vie, to rival each other
definitions.explanation: To strive to surpass each other in achievement or quality.

notes:
{競|きそ}い{合|あ}う is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧) meaning to compete with each other.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{競|きそ}う→競う：13767_kisou⟧ (to compete) + ⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧ (each other) → to compete with each other

ASPECT (ている):
{競|きそ}い{合|あ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates an ongoing competition.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{激|はげ}しく→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧{競|きそ}い{合|あ}う (compete fiercely)
- ⟦{互|たが}いに→互いに：07150_tagaini⟧{競|きそ}い{合|あ}う (compete with each other)
- ⟦{切磋琢磨|せっさたくま}→切磋琢磨：16231_sessatakuma⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{競|きそ}い{合|あ}う (compete while improving each other)

USAGE:
Implies mutual competition where both parties are actively trying to outdo each other. Often used in positive contexts where competition leads to improvement.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{競|きそ}う→競う：13767_kisou⟧: to compete (not necessarily mutual)
- ⟦{競争|きょうそう}→競争：01388_kyousou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to compete (more formal)
